name: REACT @ TAMU Chemistry (summer research training)
org: Texas A&M University, Department of Chemistry
what_you_do: Spend part of the summer on campus in a hands-on chemistry research training program. Up to 20 students learn lab skills, see research demos and prepare for chemistry research in high school.
grades: High school students (the 2026 page says as of Fall 2026)
who_can_apply: High school students who finished at least one high school chemistry course before the summer. The pages give no grade, age or residency rule. You need a recommendation from a high school chemistry teacher. Selection is merit based and space is limited to 20 students.
pay_detail: Applying is free. The registration fee is $250, due after you are accepted (2026 page). Lunch is provided.
duration: The 2026 header lists July 13 to 24, 2026 and also calls it a 6-day in-person program. The 2027 dates are not posted.
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens Jan 19, 2027. No closing date is posted. In 2026, students were notified April 24, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application, which includes a short chemistry research statement. The form sends a request to your chemistry teacher for the recommendation. Questions: tamu_react@tamu.edu.
notes: The program ran for the first time in 2025 (July 14 to 25). The fee and rules above come from the 2026 pages, so check them again when the 2027 application opens. The program site is a Google Sites page run by the department.
